subject.title: feat: add editable voice dictation to the Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw accept a new Gateway/provider-backed batch dictation RPC in the Control UI composer, or keep editable dictation under existing Talk/transcription-only flows for now?
rationale: The patch adds a new browser microphone-to-Gateway transcription boundary and a composer UX distinct from current Talk modes; automation can identify defects, but maintainers must choose whether that product boundary belongs in core Control UI now.

options.title: Accept provider-backed composer dictation after proof
options.body: Port this PR to current main, fix the accessibility issue, require redacted real behavior proof, and land only if the new Gateway RPC boundary is acceptable.

options.title: Keep dictation in Talk for now
options.body: Decline the new composer RPC and route future work through transcription-only Talk or the broader WebChat voice tracker instead.

options.title: Pause behind the broad voice tracker
options.body: Leave this PR and the paired issue open until maintainers settle the broader STT/TTS WebChat direction.

recommendation.title: Accept provider-backed composer dictation after proof
recommendation.body: Port this PR to current main, fix the accessibility issue, require redacted real behavior proof, and land only if the new Gateway RPC boundary is acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest feature-history signal from the earlier server-side dictation work and related WebChat voice implementation context.
